results.content: Redistricting has helped House Republicans build a seawall that can withstand a roughly 5-point Democratic wave. * A swing of that magnitude would produce a comfortable 230-205 Democratic majority, according to an Axios analysis of how the battle for the House would play out under different electoral scenarios. * A national swing toward Democrats like the one in Trump's first midterm would overwhelm the GOP's redistricting defenses. **By the numbers:** The current generic ballot has Democrats up roughly 6 points, which would produce a 221-214 Democratic majority in the Axios analysis. **The other side:** If Republicans outperform Trump's 2024 numbers by 5 points across congressional district
results.title: The math behind a Democratic wave — or a GOP upset - Axios

results.content: Democrats have gained sharply with Latino voters in some of the country's most competitive House districts since 2024, a new Hart Research/TelevisaUnivision poll shared exclusively with Axios shows. * Coming out of the 2024 election, Republicans hoped Trump's near-parity with Democrats among Latinos in 2024 would harden into a lasting political realignment favoring the GOP. **By the numbers:** Democrats are gaining ground with Latino voters across a survey of 17 competitive House districts, opening a 58%-35% lead on the generic congressional ballot, according to the Hart Research for TelevisaUnivision poll. * Among Spanish-language media consumers, Democrats lead the 2026 generic ballot by 1
